workflows.name: hello
workflows.title: Hello
workflows.description: A minimal example that writes a greeting in the current directory.
workflows.yaml:
description: A local greeting workflow

inputs:
  name:
    type: string
    required: true

steps:
  - name: Write greeting
    shell: "printf 'Hello, %s!\\n' {{shellQuote(name)}} > greeting.txt"

workflows.name: pre-release-checks
workflows.title: Pre-release checks
workflows.description: Runs a project’s existing verification command from its root. Supply a command you would run directly in your shell.
workflows.yaml:
description: Run the project's existing release checks in the current directory
inputs:
  command:
    type: string
    required: true
steps:
  - name: Run project checks
    shell: sh -eu -c {{shellQuote(command)}}

workflows.name: project-setup
workflows.title: Project setup
workflows.description: Installs locked dependencies in the current project. Use a disposable checkout when trying this workflow. Run it from the root of a trusted project.
workflows.yaml:
description: Install locked project dependencies in the current directory
steps:
  - name: Install dependencies
    shell: |
      set -eu
      if [ ! -f composer.lock ] && [ ! -f package-lock.json ]; then
        printf '%s\n' 'Expected composer.lock or package-lock.json in the project root.' >&2
        exit 2
      fi
      if [ -f composer.lock ]; then
        composer install --no-interaction --prefer-dist
      fi
      if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
        npm ci --ignore-scripts
      fi

workflows.name: release-notes
workflows.title: Release notes
workflows.description: Prints one bullet per commit reachable from HEAD since a selected base. It does not create a tag, write a release, or push to a remote.
workflows.yaml:
description: Preview commits since a selected ref without publishing a release
inputs:
  base:
    type: string
    required: true
steps:
  - name: Preview release notes
    shell: |
      set -eu
      base=$(git rev-parse --verify --end-of-options {{shellQuote(base)}}'^{commit}')
      git merge-base --is-ancestor "$base" HEAD
      git --no-pager log --format='- %s (%h)' "$base..HEAD"

workflows.name: review
workflows.title: Ulties project review
workflows.description: The legacy Sir review example uses Git and CodeRabbit to prepare review reports for a project under the Ulties organization.
workflows.yaml:
description: "Review a project by running tests and CodeRabbit analysis"

inputs:
  projectName:
    type: string
    required: true
    description: "Project name"
  target:
    type: string
    required: true
    description: "Target branch to review"
  base:
    type: string
    required: false
    default: "main"
    description: "Base branch for comparison"

steps:
  - task: workspace.temp
    with:
      prefix: "sir-review"
    saveAs: workspace

  - task: git.clone
    with:
      repo: "https://github.com/Ulties/{{projectName}}.git"
      folder: "{{workspace.workspace}}/{{projectName}}"
    saveAs: cloneResult

  - task: tests.auto
    with:
      cwd: "{{cloneResult.path}}"
    saveAs: testResult

  - task: files.writeMd
    with:
      path: "{{workspace.workspace}}/TEST_RESULT.md"
      title: "Test Results for {{projectName}}"
      content: "{{testResult.markdown}}"

  - task: coderabbit.review
    with:
      target: "{{target}}"
      base: "{{base}}"
      cwd: "{{cloneResult.path}}"
    saveAs: reviewResult

  - task: files.writeMd
    with:
      path: "{{workspace.workspace}}/REVIEW.md"
      title: "CodeRabbit Review for {{projectName}}"
      content: "{{reviewResult.markdown}}"

  - shell: "printf 'Results saved to %s\\n' {{shellQuote(workspace.workspace)}}"
